subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 3: 422 checks; build_ios auto-builds IV archive and link-checks; static protocol asserts
body:
DONE IP rev 3. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 422/422
    205/205 ASan+UBSan -O1, 205/205 -O2 (fake vhost/AP), 12/12 against IVs real libn2vhost.a + phone vendor set.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    builds IVs arm64 archive itself (make ios-lib, SDK present), then link-checks vcodecd:
    "link check OK: the only missing product symbol was _n2vc_hw_open_dev"
    rwjpeg_tool 68432 B; vcodecd.o 25608, n2vcd_srv.o 2616, rwjpeg.o 11152, n2jpeg_hw_vt.o 14584
    vcodecd: object only (P03 n2vc_hw_open_dev missing; link check OK)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Since rev 2:
- build_ios.sh: auto-builds IVs ios-lib archive when the SDK exists; P03 client sources are compiled into a static archive so the daemon linker pulls only the hardware back end (P03s own CLI/server files cannot duplicate vcodecd); the P03 branch was exercised in a throwaway /tmp tree with a P03-shaped n2vc_hw_open_dev and produced a linked 272304-byte Mach-O vcodecd (build-system test, not shipped).
- sdk_symbols.txt extended to every libSystem symbol the daemon + IV archive reference (each verified against the SDKs libSystem.tbd).
- vcodecd: static asserts on the frozen protocol struct sizes (hdr 16, hello 24/40, open 80/32, enc_frame 48/48, enc_set 32, simple 24) and RWVC_MSG_MAX; message bodies memcpy-ed out of the unaligned receive buffer; guest stop during AP open and ENC_SET now answers E_GUEST with the numeric n2a32 reason; client-handle PA warning now also fires for an entry with pa=0; oversized-datagram log rate-limited; run_tests uses /tmp/n2hw-ip/test so build products are not clobbered.
- install.py --force upgrade path, undo --purge-vendor, and stage.sh /tmp-only guard tested; LAYOUT install flow clarified (installer runs from the host payload, not pre-copied into root).

Open unchanged: P03 client/** (product link, client tool, real n2vc_hw_open_dev); client DMA PA source (RWVC_DMA_INFO proposed); no phone run. R1 checked the V-interface calls and found no misuse; R2 (track P reviewer) has no worker this run, so a formal R2 pass is outstanding. Full details: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md.
